title: Interface is administratively down
description: A switchport shows 'administratively down' and no traffic passes.
symptom: A connected host has no network connectivity. The switch port status is 'administratively down' even though a cable is plugged in.
diagnosis: Run 'show interfaces status' to find the port and confirm the state.
Run 'show interfaces fa0/5' to see the exact line and protocol status.
Check the running configuration for a 'shutdown' command on the interface.
Verify the correct VLAN is assigned and that the cable is good.
resolution: The interface was manually shut down. Enter interface configuration mode and apply 'no shutdown'. Confirm the status changes to 'connected' / 'up'.
